categories.label: City Water Systems
categories.intro: Municipal water in the Twin Cities is treated and safe, but it typically carries hardness minerals plus chlorine or chloramine disinfectant. These systems soften and filter every tap in the house.

categories.label: Well Water Systems
categories.intro: Private wells in Minnesota commonly carry iron, manganese and hardness, and in some areas hydrogen sulfide. Final well configuration depends on a water test — we review that with you by phone.

categories.label: Drinking Water / Reverse Osmosis
categories.intro: Point-of-use reverse osmosis treats the water you drink and cook with at a dedicated kitchen faucet. Included free with any whole-home system, or installed on its own.

categories.label: Optional Add-Ons
categories.intro: Protection layers recommended for most well-water installs.

systems.name: Whole Home Filtration & Softening System
systems.image_alt: MSP Pure Water whole-home filtration and softening system: single media tank cutaway showing carbon, softening resin and polishing gravel, with brine tank
systems.for: Twin Cities homes on municipal water that want soft water and no chlorine taste at every faucet, in one compact footprint.

stages.title: Catalytic coconut-shell carbon
stages.text: Treats chlorine, chloramine and the tastes and odors that come with municipal disinfection.

stages.title: USA-made 10% crosslinked softening resin
stages.text: Ion exchange removes the calcium and magnesium that cause hard water, scale and spotting.

stages.title: Polishing gravel bed
stages.text: Supports the media for even flow and maximum contact time.

stages.title: MSP ProValve control
stages.text: Automatically backwashes and regenerates the system. Ceramic-disc valve with a 72-hour memory backup.

included: Reverse osmosis drinking-water system (tank or tankless)

systems.name: Dual Tank Whole Home Filtration System
systems.image_alt: Dual Tank Whole Home Water Filtration System: softening resin tank and carbon filtration tank cutaways with brine tank
systems.for: Larger households and heavy water use: carbon filtration and softening each get their own full-strength tank.

stages.title: Dedicated catalytic carbon tank
stages.text: Granular catalytic coconut-shell carbon treats chlorine, chloramine, taste and odor.

stages.title: Dedicated softening tank
stages.text: High-capacity 10% crosslinked resin removes hardness minerals.

stages.title: Polishing gravel in both tanks
stages.text: Keeps flow even and prevents channeling.

stages.title: One ProValve controls both tanks
stages.text: Backwashes and regenerates automatically, including the carbon tank.

included: Reverse osmosis drinking-water system (tank or tankless)

systems.name: Whole Home Complete Salt-Free Filtration System
systems.image_alt: Whole Home Complete Salt-Free Filtration System: carbon filtration tank cutaway and salt-free conditioning tank
systems.for: Homeowners who want whole-home carbon filtration and scale protection with no salt bags, no brine discharge and no regeneration cycles.

stages.title: Whole-home coconut-shell carbon
stages.text: Removes chlorine, chloramine, chemicals and odors from all your water.

stages.title: Salt-free conditioning tank
stages.text: Transforms hardness minerals so they no longer form scale. It does not remove calcium and magnesium the way a softener does, so it will not give the soft-water feel.

stages.title: Polishing gravel
stages.text: Supports even water distribution through the media.

stages.title: No electricity, no drain, no salt
stages.text: The simplest system to own.

systems.name: Dual Tank Well Water Whole Home Filtration System
systems.image_alt: MSP Pure Water dual tank well-water system: softening resin tank and Katalox Light media tank cutaways with brine tank
systems.for: Minnesota well homes dealing with iron staining, manganese and hard water, treated without chemicals.

stages.title: MSP AIO ProValve air oxidation
stages.text: Keeps a pressurized air pocket in the tank. Dissolved iron and manganese oxidize into solid particles the media can capture. No chemicals added.

stages.title: Katalox Light media
stages.text: Traps the oxidized particles and nudges pH up for better taste. Self-cleans with automatic backwashing.

stages.title: Dedicated softening tank
stages.text: USA-made resin removes calcium and magnesium hardness.

stages.title: Automatic backwash on both tanks
stages.text: Maintenance stays close to zero.

included: Reverse osmosis drinking-water system (tank or tankless)
systems.note: Final well-water configuration may depend on water test results. We review testing as part of your phone consultation.

systems.name: Iron & Sulfur Treatment System
systems.image_alt: Iron & Sulfur Treatment System: hydrogen peroxide injection panel, holding tank, carbon and softening tanks
systems.for: The system for rotten-egg sulfur odor, and for wells with heavier iron loads where air oxidation alone is not enough.

stages.title: Hydrogen peroxide injection panel
stages.text: Doses peroxide the moment water enters the home, breaking down dissolved iron and hydrogen sulfide.

stages.title: Dedicated catalytic carbon tank
stages.text: Captures the oxidized particles and consumes the peroxide so it never reaches your faucets.

stages.title: Dedicated softening tank
stages.text: Ion-exchange resin removes hardness for fully softened water.

stages.title: Automatic backwashing
stages.text: Flushes captured contaminants to drain.

included: Reverse osmosis drinking-water system (tank or tankless)
systems.note: Final well-water configuration may depend on water test results. We review testing as part of your phone consultation.

systems.name: HW800 AlkaPro Tankless Reverse Osmosis
systems.badge: Included Free With Any Whole-Home System
systems.image_alt: HW800 AlkaPro tankless reverse osmosis unit, white with black front panel, next to a chrome drinking-water faucet
systems.for: Kitchens where under-sink space matters and you want drinking water treated on demand, with minerals added back for taste.

stages.title: 7-stage filtration
stages.text: Pre-filtration, a 0.0001-micron spiral-flow RO membrane and post-filtration.

stages.title: Alkaline remineralization
stages.text: Adds minerals back after the membrane for taste and balanced pH.

stages.title: Auto flush & twist-out filters
stages.text: The membrane self-flushes and filter changes are tool-free.

systems.name: Traditional Tank Reverse Osmosis System
systems.badge: Included Free With Any Whole-Home System
systems.image_alt: Tank reverse osmosis system: multi-stage filter bank with pressurized storage tank and chrome faucet
systems.for: The proven under-sink configuration: purified water stored in a pressurized tank and delivered instantly when you open the faucet.

stages.title: Multi-stage prefiltration
stages.text: Sediment and carbon stages protect the membrane and remove chlorine.

stages.title: Reverse osmosis membrane
stages.text: Rejects 94–99% of total dissolved solids.

stages.title: Pressurized steel storage tank
stages.text: A food-grade bladder keeps purified water pressurized and ready to pour instantly.

systems.name: Pre-System Sediment Filter
systems.image_alt: Pre-system sediment filter with blue housing and black cap
systems.for: The first line of defense on a well. Captures sand, silt, dirt and rust before they reach the resin, media and valves downstream.
included: Installed ahead of your whole-home system

systems.name: Whole-Home UV Purifier
systems.image_alt: Whole-house ultraviolet purifier: stainless steel chamber with UV lamps, quartz sleeves, ballast and mounting clamps
systems.for: An additional disinfection barrier for well water. UV light inactivates microorganisms as water flows through a stainless chamber. It does not remove iron, sediment or dissolved chemicals, so it is installed after filtration.
